verdicts.reason: A: the quote, attribution and logo sit together in one left block and read left to right, but the logo is now about as big as the attribution and floats centred under it, off the text's left edge. The huge quote mark crowds the copy, and the attribution is oversized next to the quote. B: the attribution is cut off from its quote and floats mid-canvas in tiny, hard-to-read type. The quote is jammed into the bottom-left with an orphaned quote mark far above it, the logo is oversized in the centre, and the right-hand circle and can are small and leave dead space, so the layout looks scattered.
